preconditions.description: The number of remaining boxes n is an integer between 0 and 4 inclusive.
The list of given candy counts a has exactly n elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 500 for x in a)
preconditions.description: Each given candy count is an integer between 1 and 500 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The first line of output is either YES or NO.

postconditions.expression: stdout.startswith('NO') or (len([int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]]) == 4 - n)
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, exactly 4-n additional integers are provided in the subsequent lines.

postconditions.expression: not (stdout.startswith('YES') and any(not (1 <= int(x) <= 10**6) for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, all added numbers are integers between 1 and 10^6 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: not (stdout.startswith('YES') and not is_valid_solution(a, [int(x) for x in stdout.strip().split()[1:]]))
postconditions.description: If the answer is YES, the combined set of 4 numbers (given and added) satisfies the condition that mean equals median equals range.
If the answer is NO, no valid set of 4 numbers containing the given numbers exists that satisfies the condition.
